title: Add White, Black, Orange, and Yellow UI themes

requirements.text: Extend the theme system so users can select four themes: White, Black, Orange, and Yellow, with the selection persisted in localStorage and applied on page load.

quotes: can you add a white theme a black theme a orange theme a yellow theme

acceptanceCriteria: Theme options include exactly: White, Black, Orange, Yellow.
Selected theme is persisted under the existing theme storage key (or a clearly documented replacement key with backward compatibility for existing 'light'/'dark' stored values).
Reloading the page preserves the previously selected theme.
No console errors occur when switching themes.

requirements.text: Update the global CSS theme variables in frontend/src/index.css to define appropriate CSS custom property sets for the White, Black, Orange, and Yellow themes so that Tailwind tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, border-border, bg-primary, bg-accent, ring, etc.) visually change with the selected theme.

quotes: can you add a white theme a black theme a orange theme a yellow theme

acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four themes produces a clearly distinct look by changing at least background/foreground/card/border/primary/accent/ring variables.
Black theme results in a dark UI (equivalent to current dark-mode behavior or better).
White theme results in a light UI (equivalent to current light-mode behavior or better).
Orange and Yellow themes apply orange/yellow-forward primary/accent styling while maintaining readable contrast for text and controls.

requirements.text: Update the bottom ThemeToggleBar to let the user switch among the four themes (White, Black, Orange, Yellow) and ensure aria-label text accurately reflects the action and the available themes.

quotes: can you add a white theme a black theme a orange theme a yellow theme

acceptanceCriteria: ThemeToggleBar provides a control that cycles or selects White/Black/Orange/Yellow.
The theme control’s visible label matches the currently selected theme.
aria-label(s) mention the correct theme names and no longer refer only to 'Light/Dark mode' if that is no longer the only behavior.
The existing color-scheme switcher (Blue/Purple/Green) continues to work as before.

requirements.text: Ensure the circular indicator in ThemeToggleBar continues to reflect the currently active theme colors by relying on existing semantic tokens (e.g., bg-primary and bg-accent) so it updates automatically for White/Black/Orange/Yellow themes as well.

quotes: can you add a white theme a black theme a orange theme a yellow theme

acceptanceCriteria: Switching to each of the four themes updates the indicator colors without additional user actions.
Indicator uses semantic theme tokens (primary/accent) rather than hardcoded colors.
Indicator remains visible with sufficient contrast across all four themes.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components); only compose them.
Do not modify immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep backend as single-actor Motoko; no backend changes are required for theme selection.
nonGoals: Adding additional authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Adding backend persistence for theme preferences (localStorage-only is sufficient).
Creating new pages or routes unrelated to theme selection.
